what_it_is.prose: Telair International (a TransDigm group company) is an OEM of aircraft cargo-loading and handling systems, including military pallet-locking systems, cargo floors and roller/conveyor systems. Its equipment is fitted to military airlifters of the C-130 and C-295 class, but as an embedded cargo sub-system supplied through the airframer rather than through any discrete, publicly documented India defence contract. Recorded as an honest Tier C component-supplier card.
